messages:
elaine: Quick ask for the launch post — can eng/runtime run a compact smoke vs quantized variants and confirm methodology?

mike: Need coldstart p95/p99, embed batch latency (20 items), and fp16 vs 8bit. Also two sanitized example outputs for the blog.

sam: OK. Drop payloads + model names and preferred region. Also which warmup?

elaine: Payloads = short support summary, long multi-turn (~2k tokens), embed batch (20). Models = rwd-1-xl-fp16, rwd-1-xl-8bit, rwd-2-base-fp16. Region = us-west1.

elaine: ```short: {"prompt":"Summarize user's issue and suggest two next steps."} long: [turns...] embed: [20 short texts]```

tara: Warmup affects tails — can we do a compact compare: 15s warmup vs 3m warmup? capture tokenization time separately for the long convo.

mike: 150 samples per payload is fine for a quick smoke. we'll note that larger 1k runs were done offline for validation.

sam: Plan: 3 payloads x 3 model configs x 2 warmups x 150 = 2700 requests. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokenization split, and include 2 example traces for p99 outliers. I'll post a one-paragraph summary + artifacts in this thread.

elaine: Need smoke numbers + example outputs by EOD Thursday. Add one-line caveat for the blog: "compact smoke; larger validation runs corroborate p99 within ~10%" unless you see major variance.

runtime-bot: queue accepted. sam owns run; tara will sanity-check artifacts. ETA Thu 6pm PST (4850000201).
